purpose: Create a safe basis for customer-facing strength/cost, work-expression, relationship-expression and context visuals by recording explicit customer confirmation instead of inferring generic strengths, weaknesses or fit from heterogeneous scores.

inputSchema.signalRef: required governed Profile signal or perspective reference

derivedCustomerOutputs.strengthEvidence: Only HELPS_ME or BOTH confirmations may appear on the strength side; label as an observed resource, not an objective strength.
derivedCustomerOutputs.costEvidence: Only COSTS_ME or BOTH confirmations, or already admitted SOURCE_TENSION/POTENTIAL_FRICTION_TARGET evidence, may appear on the cost side; never relabel a low score as weakness.
derivedCustomerOutputs.workExpression: Requires WORK context confirmation or native O*NET interest evidence; no job-fit conclusion.
derivedCustomerOutputs.relationshipExpression: Requires RELATIONSHIP context confirmation or existing relationship-profile evidence; no compatibility score.
derivedCustomerOutputs.decisionEvidence: May display source-scoped decision/planning/risk signals plus explicit Current Reality confirmation; no fixed decision type.
derivedCustomerOutputs.environmentEvidence: May display ENVIRONMENT_FIT self-report plus explicit Current Reality context; no objective environment-fit conclusion.
